notes: Field order is the order of as_dict(lite=False): the HDF5 compound member order.
Types are the declared ones (annotation or FieldMetadata.dtype), not read from files.
interaction_mode and interaction_type are plain int64 with no enum: SPINE interprets them under interaction_scheme (see scheme_dependent_enum on those fields and enums[*].scheme_dependent).
derived fields (SPINE stored_property) take as default the value on a default-constructed object (default_source = default_instance).
float32/float64 defaults 'nan', 'inf' and '-inf' are strings in this file.
